company.name: Find Nuclei
identity_limitations: Website links to the Find-Nuclei GitHub organization/repository; inspectable project linkage, not proof of legal entity or named founder.

track.rationale: Microscopy-data viewing, annotation and sharing infrastructure for research laboratories.

plain_language_product_or_program: Find Nuclei provides a browser viewer and local data server that help scientists open, annotate and share large microscopy datasets without moving all their images into a new cloud system.
user_or_patient_population: Microscopy researchers, imaging core facilities and laboratory teams handling OME-Zarr datasets.

source_groups.claim_origin: Company pages and company-linked project repository/citation
independence_limitations: GitHub hosts the project's own material; separate URLs/host do not make independent corroboration.

sources.paraphrase: Current site offers a browser OME-Zarr viewer, local data server and embeddable viewer, linked to documentation and GitHub. It describes free existing tools and local image handling.
limitations: Text inspected; no image opened, server run or privacy/performance test.

sources.title: About Find Nuclei
sources.paraphrase: The company targets large multi-channel, high-content and volumetric microscopy data. It explains open-standard/local workflows but identifies no individual founder or developer in the inspected page.
limitations: No individual attribution, relevant work history or company rights established.

sources.title: Find Nuclei Platform
sources.date_basis: Forward-looking launch year explicitly shown in direct HTTP snapshot; not a completed launch.
sources.paraphrase: The collaboration workspace is a planned paid per-user product for 2027, currently a waitlist. Team workspaces and experiment tracking are planned features, distinct from existing free tools.
limitations: Roadmap is not current functionality, revenue or customer adoption.
Older indexed About material showed 2026; current direct platform/about snapshots show 2027 and take precedence for current plan.

sources.title: Find Nuclei Viewer repository
sources.paraphrase: Public repository contains project files, guides and linked microscopy examples for a browser viewer, with annotations, segmentation-label display and measurement-table phenotyping described. It provides concrete implementation/documentation leads rather than only a sales page.
limitations: Source tree/README existence inspected, not a code audit or executed workflow.
Segmentation-mask viewing is not evidence that the product generated validated segmentation.
Public repository does not imply an open-source license.

sources.title: Find Nuclei Viewer CITATION.cff
sources.date_basis: Project-declared version/date-released; not independently verified release or incorporation date.
sources.paraphrase: Citation metadata names the corporate project Find Nuclei as author, gives release date 19 September 2026 and marks the license proprietary. It does not identify an individual contributor or founder.
limitations: Corporate authorship cannot establish person identity, founder contribution, sustained execution or asset ownership.
